dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

# Install system dependencies required by pycurl, PIL, and other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    libssl-dev \
    libjpeg-dev \
    zlib1g-dev \
    libfreetype6-dev \
    libpng-dev \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt uses 'Pillow' instead of 'PIL' as it's the modern fork. Additional system packages are installed in the Dockerfile to support pycurl (libcurl, ssl), PIL/Pillow (image libraries), and compilation tools for scipy/numpy. The slim Python image is used as requested, with unnecessary package caches cleaned to minimize image size.
